svg.title: SyncLayer slide: the nine agents
svg.desc: oracle: Maps an unfamiliar repo or area. Model haiku. Tools: Read, Grep, Glob. no Edit/Write. scout: Checks official docs and libraries. Model sonnet. Tools: WebSearch, WebFetch, Read, Grep, Glob. no Edit/Write. atlas: Plans and designs the change. Model claude-fable-5-2. Tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Write. writes: the plan file. forge: Implements one unit of work. Model sonnet. Tools: Read, Edit, Write, Grep, Glob, Bash. writes: code and its tests. sentinel: Runs and extends the tests. Model sonnet. Tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write. writes tests · guarded Bash. auditor: Reviews the diff, independently. Model opus. Tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash. no Edit/Write · guarded Bash. shield: Reviews the diff for security. Model opus. Tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash. no Edit/Write · guarded Bash. debugger: Finds the root cause of a failure. Model opus. Tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash. no Edit/Write · guarded Bash. scribe: Keeps the project docs current. Model sonnet. Tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Edit, Write. writes: documentation only. The guard is a heuristic, not a sandbox.
